descriptionByLocale.it: Si otterrà una prima visione della pratica delle professioni sanitarie. Potrai conoscere la vita quotidiana di un assistente medico EFZ. Le possibilità dipendono dall'offerta della struttura. L'età minima per un tirocinio elettivo professionale è di 13 anni o studenti del secondo livello superiore (8 ° grado). La durata dello stage professionale è di 1 giorno. Prerequisito: scuola secondaria o di distretto. Le applicazioni del Canton Aargau e dell'Aarau Agglomeration sono preferite. Consigliamo un viaggio di massimo 45 minuti. Possibili sedi: dipartimenti dell'Ospedale cantonale Aarau o della KSA alla stazione La posizione non può essere scelta liberamente, è divisa in base all'offerta.
descriptionByLocale.en: You will get a first insight into the practice of the health professions. You will get to know the everyday life of a medical practice assistant EFZ. The possibilities depend on the offer of the establishment. The minimum age for a vocational elective traineeship is 13 years or pupils from the 2nd upper level (8th grade). The duration of the vocational internship is 1 day. Prerequisite: secondary or district school. Applications from the Canton of Aargau and from the Agglomeration Aarau are preferred. We recommend a journey of a maximum of 45 minutes. Possible locations: departments in the Cantonal Hospital Aarau or in the KSA at the station The location cannot be chosen freely, it is divided according to offer.
descriptionByLocale.de: Sie erhalten einen ersten Einblick in die Praxis der Gesundheitsberufe. Sie lernen den Alltag einer/eines Medizinischen Praxisassistentin/Praxisassistenten EFZ kennen. Die Möglichkeiten richten sich nach dem Angebot des Betriebs. Das Mindestalter für ein Berufswahlpraktikum beträgt 13 Jahre bzw. Schülerinnen und Schüler ab der 2. Oberstufe (8. Klasse). Die Dauer des Berufswahlpraktikums beträgt 1 Tag. Voraussetzung: Sekundar- oder Bezirksschule. Bewerbungen aus dem Kanton Aargau sowie aus der Agglomeration Aarau werden bevorzugt. Wir empfehlen einen Anfahrtsweg von maximal 45 Minuten. Mögliche Einsatzorte: Abteilungen im Kantonsspital Aarau oder im KSA am Bahnhof Der Einsatzort kann nicht frei gewählt werden, es erfolgt eine Einteilung je nach Angebot.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Vous aurez un premier aperçu de la pratique des professions de la santé. Vous apprendrez à connaître la vie quotidienne d'un assistant de médecine EFZ. Les possibilités dépendent de l'offre de l'établissement. L'âge minimum d'un stage professionnel électif est de 13 ans ou d'élèves du 2ème niveau supérieur (8ème niveau). La durée du stage professionnel est d'un jour. Préalable : école secondaire ou de district. Les demandes du canton d'Argovie et de l'agglomération d'Aarau sont privilégiées. Nous recommandons un voyage d'un maximum de 45 minutes. Emplacements possibles: départements de l'hôpital cantonal Aarau ou de la KSA à la station L'emplacement ne peut pas être choisi librement, il est divisé selon l'offre.

titleByLocale.fr: Dipl. Spécialiste en radiologie / Spécialiste en radiologie

descriptionByLocale.it:
Compiti:
• Siamo dotati di dispositivi terapeutici all'avanguardia basati su attrezzature varian.

• Oltre alle terapie standard come IMRT, VMAT, DIBH, 4D, SBRT, SRS, SRT, offriamo anche ipertermia (profondi e superfici), terapia ortovoltaica e brachiterapia.

• Il dipartimento ha la sua TAC per la pianificazione della terapia.

• I vostri compiti principali includono l'implementazione indipendente della radioterapia sull'acceleratore lineare e l'implementazione della CT di pianificazione.

• Hai la possibilità di lavorare in tutti i posti di lavoro menzionati nel principio di rotazione.

• La cooperazione costruttiva, interdisciplinare e interprofessionale è una parte essenziale del loro lavoro.

Requisiti
• Hai completato l'allenamento come Dipl. Specialista di radiologia HF o istruzione straniera equivalente riconosciuto dalla SRC.

• Idealmente hanno esperienza professionale in radiooncologia, sono versatili, impegnati e flessibili.

• Valgono un compito responsabile e indipendente.

• Buona conoscenza del tedesco è desiderato.

• Non solo apprezzi il lavoro di squadra, ma anche la cooperazione interdisciplinare, sono affidabili e interessati alla vostra formazione e formazione.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Tasks:
• We are equipped with state-of-the-art therapeutic devices based on Varian equipment.

• In addition to standard therapies such as IMRT, VMAT, DIBH, 4D, SBRT, SRS, SRT, we also offer hyperthermia (depths and surfaces), orthovoltage therapy and brachytherapy.

• The department has its own CT for therapy planning.

• Your main tasks include the independent implementation of radiotherapy on the linear accelerator and the implementation of planning CT.

• You have the opportunity to work in all mentioned workplaces in the rotation principle.

• Constructive, interdisciplinary and interprofessional cooperation is an essential part of their work.

Requirements
• You have completed training as a Dipl. Radiology specialist HF or equivalent foreign education recognised by the SRC.

• They ideally have professional experience in radio-oncology, are versatile, engaged and flexible.

• They value a responsible and independent task.

• Good knowledge of German is desired.

• You not only appreciate teamwork, but also interdisciplinary cooperation, are reliable and interested in your own further education and training.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Radio-Onkologie

Stellenantritt: Per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung, unberfristet

Aufgaben:

• Wir bieten neben den Standardtherapien wie IMRT, VMAT, DIBH, 4D, SBRT, SRS, SRT auch Hyperthermie (Tiefen und Oberflächen), Orthovolttherapie und Brachytherapie an.

• Sie haben die Möglichkeit, an allen genannten Arbeitsplätzen im Rotationsprinzip zu arbeiten.

• Eine konstruktive, interdisziplinäre und interprofessionelle Zusammenarbeit ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil ihrer Arbeit.

Anforderungen:
• Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Dipl. Radiologiefachperson HF oder einer gleichwertigen, vom SRK anerkannten, ausländischen Ausbildung.

• Sie haben idealerweise Berufserfahrung in der Radio-Onkologie, sind vielseitig interessiert, engagiert und flexibel.

• Sie schätzen eine verantwortungsvolle und selbständige Aufgabe.

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse sind erwünscht.

• Sie schätzen nicht nur Teamarbeit, sondern auch interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit, sind zuverlässig und an Ihrer eigenen Fort- und Weiterbildung interessiert.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Clinic for Intensive Care Medicine

Job opening: From now on or by agreement, indefinitely

Tasks:
• Self-responsible, practical treatment of patients according to evidence-based intensive care guidelines. Our clinic covers the entire spectrum of interdisciplinary intensive care medicine – with the exception of transplantation medicine, combustion medicine and heart surgery

• Regular participation in bedside teaching as well as in interdisciplinary and interprofessional training

• Mentoring and supervision of rotary doctors and specialist assistant doctors

• Cooperation in the further development of the clinic through active participation in the creation and optimization of treatment concepts

• Active participation in and supervision of simulation trainings

• Possibility to deepen your knowledge in echocardiography (including echocrotation in cardiology) and sonography including acquisition of the SGUM Certificate of Ability (FA) POCUS

• Opportunity to participate in research projects

Requirements
• Federal medical diploma or MEBEKO recognition

• Federal Specialist Title Intensive Medicine present or submitted, or confirmation of equivalent training by the SGI

• Completed second specialist training (Anesthesia or General Internal Medicine) beneficial

• Strong self-employment, high social skills and very good communication skills

• Teamwork and enjoyment of interdisciplinary, constructive exchange

descriptionByLocale.it:
Compiti:
• Attività medica auto-responsabile in un ospedale centrale della categoria A1

• Cura indipendente e trattamento dei pazienti affetti da dolore

• Partecipazione alla conferenza mensile interdisciplinare sul dolore

• Cooperazione facoltativa in anestesia adulta attraverso l'intero spettro anestesiologico del KSA

• Collaborazione nei progetti interni e interclinici e nella formazione degli assistenti

Requisiti
• Diploma medico svizzero o formazione equivalente con riconoscimento MEBEKO

• Capacità di superare la terapia del dolore intervenzionale SSIPM (o quasi completamento)

• Titolo specialistico approvato dalla Svizzera Anestesiologia (se si desidera la cooperazione in anestesia) con esperienza in tutte le aree dell'anestesia clinica (chirurgia cardiaca di eccezione e trapianto)

• Giocatore di squadra/in

Benvenuti all'Ospedale cantonale Aarau (KSA).
Sia nell'Ospedale cantonale Aarau, nelle località KSA Bahnhof Aarau, KSA Lenzburg o KSA Frick – siamo lì per voi tutto il giorno. Con la nostra vasta gamma di servizi, dalla cura di base alla medicina altamente specializzata, siamo competenti e affidabili in tutte le posizioni.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Tasks:
• Self-responsible medical activity in a center hospital of category A1

• Independent care and treatment of pain patients

• Participation in the monthly interdisciplinary pain conference

• Optional cooperation in adult anesthesia across the entire anesthesiological spectrum of the KSA

• Collaboration in internal and inter-clinic projects and in assistant training

Requirements
• Swiss medical diploma or equivalent training with MEBEKO recognition

• Ability to pass Interventional Pain Therapy SSIPM (or near completion)

• Swiss-approved specialist title Anesthesiology (if cooperation in anesthesia is desired) with experience in all areas of clinical anesthesia (exception cardiac and transplantation surgery)

• Team player/in

descriptionByLocale.it:
Compiti:
Come studente, siete congiuntamente responsabili per l'attuazione e il monitoraggio dell'anestesia in stretta collaborazione con il servizio medico. Cura completa del paziente prima, durante e dopo la procedura.
Si beneficia di un corso post-laurea completo di 2 anni.
• Vi offriamo un insegnamento e una formazione da parte di formatori professionali esperti e un accompagnamento da parte di specialisti in pratica. Insieme con il fornitore educativo della scuola di Aargau di Anestesia, la cura intensiva e la cura di emergenza (afsain), che organizza l'istruzione teorica, sosteniamo e sosteniamo i nostri studenti nella vita quotidiana.

Requisiti
Sei una personalità impegnata e aperta e hai una laurea in Dipl. Specialista in allattamento HF, Bachelor of Science in Nursing FH o un diploma straniero in allattamento riconosciuto come equivalente e almeno 6 mesi di esperienza professionale in cura acuta in un ospedale o in una clinica. Porti abilità manuali e tocco tecnico, sei flessibile, orientato al team, comunicativo e vuoi sviluppare ulteriormente.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Tasks:
As a student, you are jointly responsible for the implementation and monitoring of anesthesia in close cooperation with the medical service. Comprehensive patient care before, during and after the procedure.
You benefit from a comprehensive 2-year postgraduate course.
• We offer you a teaching and coaching by experienced vocational trainers and an accompaniment by specialists in practice. Together with the educational provider of the Aargau School of Anesthesia, Intensive Care and Emergency Care (afsain), which organizes theoretical education, we support and support our students in everyday life.

Requirements
You are a committed, open-minded personality and have a degree as a Dipl. Nursing specialist HF, Bachelor of Science in Nursing FH or a foreign diploma in nursing recognised as equivalent and at least 6 months of professional experience in acute care in a hospital or clinic. You bring manual skill and technical flair, you are flexible, team-oriented, communicative and you want to develop further.

descriptionByLocale.it: Si otterrà una prima visione della pratica delle professioni sanitarie. Potrai conoscere la vita quotidiana di un assistente medico EFZ. Le possibilità dipendono dall'offerta della struttura. L'età minima per un tirocinio elettivo professionale è di 13 anni o studenti del secondo livello superiore (8 ° grado). La durata dello stage professionale è di 1 giorno. Prerequisito: scuola secondaria o di distretto. Le applicazioni del Canton Aargau e dell'Aarau Agglomeration sono preferite. Consigliamo un viaggio di massimo 45 minuti. Possibili sedi: dipartimenti dell'Ospedale cantonale Aarau o della KSA alla stazione La posizione non può essere scelta liberamente, è divisa in base all'offerta.
descriptionByLocale.en: You will get a first insight into the practice of the health professions. You will get to know the everyday life of a medical practice assistant EFZ. The possibilities depend on the offer of the establishment. The minimum age for a vocational elective traineeship is 13 years or pupils from the 2nd upper level (8th grade). The duration of the vocational internship is 1 day. Prerequisite: secondary or district school. Applications from the Canton of Aargau and from the Agglomeration Aarau are preferred. We recommend a journey of a maximum of 45 minutes. Possible locations: departments in the Cantonal Hospital Aarau or in the KSA at the station The location cannot be chosen freely, it is divided according to offer.
descriptionByLocale.de: Sie erhalten einen ersten Einblick in die Praxis der Gesundheitsberufe. Sie lernen den Alltag einer/eines Medizinischen Praxisassistentin/Praxisassistenten EFZ kennen. Die Möglichkeiten richten sich nach dem Angebot des Betriebs. Das Mindestalter für ein Berufswahlpraktikum beträgt 13 Jahre bzw. Schülerinnen und Schüler ab der 2. Oberstufe (8. Klasse). Die Dauer des Berufswahlpraktikums beträgt 1 Tag. Voraussetzung: Sekundar- oder Bezirksschule. Bewerbungen aus dem Kanton Aargau sowie aus der Agglomeration Aarau werden bevorzugt. Wir empfehlen einen Anfahrtsweg von maximal 45 Minuten. Mögliche Einsatzorte: Abteilungen im Kantonsspital Aarau oder im KSA am Bahnhof Der Einsatzort kann nicht frei gewählt werden, es erfolgt eine Einteilung je nach Angebot.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Vous aurez un premier aperçu de la pratique des professions de la santé. Vous apprendrez à connaître la vie quotidienne d'un assistant de médecine EFZ. Les possibilités dépendent de l'offre de l'établissement. L'âge minimum d'un stage professionnel électif est de 13 ans ou d'élèves du 2ème niveau supérieur (8ème niveau). La durée du stage professionnel est d'un jour. Préalable : école secondaire ou de district. Les demandes du canton d'Argovie et de l'agglomération d'Aarau sont privilégiées. Nous recommandons un voyage d'un maximum de 45 minutes. Emplacements possibles: départements de l'hôpital cantonal Aarau ou de la KSA à la station L'emplacement ne peut pas être choisi librement, il est divisé selon l'offre.

Compiti:
• Diventerai membro del team di produzione citostatica dell'ospedale Pharmaceuticals. Essi producono chemoterapies paziente-specifiche assistite dal computer in condizioni asettiche secondo le specifiche GMP.

Service-/Maintenance Technician Heating-Cooling — Canton Hospital Aarau (KSA), Aarau

The Canton Hospital Aarau (KSA) is seeking a skilled Service-/Maintenance Technician Heating-Cooling to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for the maintenance, repair, and installation of heating, ventilation, air conditioning (HVAC), and refrigeration systems in our hospital facilities. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, excellent problem-solving skills, and a commitment to ensuring the smooth operation of critical infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities:
- Perform routine and preventive maintenance on HVAC and refrigeration systems.
- Conduct repairs and troubleshooting of heating, cooling, and refrigeration equipment.
- Install and commission new HVAC and refrigeration systems.
- Ensure compliance with safety regulations and hospital standards.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve technical issues.
- Document maintenance activities and system performance.
- Participate in emergency response and system breakdown management.

Requirements:
- Completed vocational training or equivalent in HVAC or refrigeration technology.
- Several years of experience in HVAC and refrigeration maintenance.
- Knowledge of relevant safety regulations and hospital standards.
- Strong technical skills and hands-on problem-solving abilities.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Good communication skills in German and English.
- Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel.

We offer:
- A dynamic and challenging work environment in a leading healthcare institution.
- Competitive salary and benefits.
- Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
- A supportive and collaborative team.

If you are a passionate and experienced Service-/Maintenance Technician Heating-Cooling with a commitment to quality and patient care, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your application including your CV and any relevant certificates to [contact information].

The Canton Hospital Aarau (KSA) is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates.

Aufgaben:
• Sie stellen eine vollständige administrative Fallführung sicher.

• Sie koordinieren und begleiten ärztliche Visiten und übernehmen die Nachbearbeitung (z.B. Therapieanmeldungen).

• Sie sind die administrative Anlaufstelle für Patientinnen und Patienten sowie für interne und externe Stellen (z.B. Sozialdienste, Kostenträger).

Anforderungen:
• Sie bringen eine med. Ausbildung als Med. Praxisassistent/in oder Fachperson Gesundheit mit.

• Sie verfügen idealerweise über eine Weiterbildung als Arztsekretär/in und bringen Erfahrung in einem Akutspital mit.

• Sie besitzen sehr gute Deutsch- und IT-Kenntnisse.

• Sie arbeiten gerne selbständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert.

• Sie haben einen empathischen Umgang mit Patientinnen und Patienten.

Herzlich willkommen im Kantonsspital Aarau (KSA).
Ob im Kantonsspital Aarau, an den Standorten KSA Bahnhof Aarau, KSA Lenzburg oder KSA Frick – wir sind rund um die Uhr für Sie da. Mit unserem breiten Angebot, von der Grundversorgung bis hin zur hochspezialisierten Medizin, stehen wir Ihnen an allen Standorten kompetent und zuverlässig zur Seite.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Tâches :
• Ils assurent une gestion administrative complète de l'affaire.

• Ils coordonnent et accompagnent les visites médicales et prennent en charge la post-traitement (par exemple, les enregistrements thérapeutiques).

• Ils sont le point de contact administratif pour les patients ainsi que pour les organismes internes et externes (p. ex. services sociaux, transporteurs de coûts).

Exigences
• Apportez un médicament. Formation comme assistant médical ou spécialiste de la santé.

• Idéalement, ils ont une formation continue en tant que secrétaire médical et apportent de l'expérience dans un hôpital aigu.

• Ils ont une très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'informatique.

• Ils aiment travailler de façon indépendante, structurée et orientée vers la solution.

• Ils ont une approche empathique des patients.

Bienvenue à l'hôpital cantonal Aarau (KSA).
Que ce soit à l'hôpital cantonal Aarau, aux emplacements KSA Bahnhof Aarau, KSA Lenzburg ou KSA Frick – nous sommes là pour vous 24h/24. Avec notre large gamme de services, des soins de base à la médecine hautement spécialisée, nous sommes compétents et fiables à tous les endroits.
